  "functional_risks": [
    "Potential impact on screen readers that rely on tabindex=0 for navigating the list via Tab (e.g., Talkback). However, list items remain accessible via aria-activedescendant and arrow-key navigation, so the risk is low."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "With suggestions visible, pressing Tab moves focus to the next field (#dietary).",
    "Arrow Up/Down keys still navigate suggestions and update aria-activedescendant.",
    "Enter key selects the highlighted suggestion and closes the popup.",
    "Esc key closes the popup.",
    "List items are not focusable via Tab when the popup is open.",
    "When the popup is closed, list items remain non-focusable due to the hidden attribute."
  ]
}
